    "statusCode": 200,
    "data": {
        "tweets": [
            {
                "_id": "6a33a80d2db3aa1dbd1eef94",
                "owner": "6a30f0caf89b6708cf12a313",
                "content": "If you could give your 18-year-old self just one sentence of advice, what would it be? Let's see them 👇",
                "createdAt": "2026-06-18T08:10:53.321Z",
                "updatedAt": "2026-06-18T08:10:53.321Z",
                "__v": 0
            },
            {
                "_id": "6a33a7ea2db3aa1dbd1eef93",
                "owner": "6a30f0caf89b6708cf12a313",
                "content": "The best investments don't come from the stock market. They come from the books you read, the skills you learn, and the health choices you make daily.",
                "createdAt": "2026-06-18T08:10:18.731Z",
                "updatedAt": "2026-06-18T08:10:18.731Z",
                "__v": 0
            },
            {
                "_id": "6a33a7cc2db3aa1dbd1eef92",
                "owner": "6a30f0caf89b6708cf12a313",
                "content": "A clean desktop or a well-organized workspace clears mental clutter instantly. Take 5 minutes to organize your digital space today. 🧹",
                "createdAt": "2026-06-18T08:09:48.316Z",
                "updatedAt": "2026-06-18T08:09:48.316Z",
                "__v": 0
            },
            {
                "_id": "6a33a7ae2db3aa1dbd1eef91",
                "owner": "6a30f0caf89b6708cf12a313",
                "content": "Open-source communities are built on sharing knowledge freely. What is one thing you learned today that you can share with someone else? 🤝",
                "createdAt": "2026-06-18T08:09:18.584Z",
                "updatedAt": "2026-06-18T08:09:18.584Z",
                "__v": 0
            },
            {
                "_id": "6a33a7a12db3aa1dbd1eef90",
                "owner": "6a30f0caf89b6708cf12a313",
                "content": "Data without context is just noise. Spend more time understanding the 'why' behind your metrics instead of just tracking the numbers. 📊",
                "createdAt": "2026-06-18T08:09:05.105Z",
                "updatedAt": "2026-06-18T08:09:05.105Z",
                "__v": 0
            },
            {
                "_id": "6a33a7942db3aa1dbd1eef8f",
                "owner": "6a30f0caf89b6708cf12a313",
                "content": "AI won't replace you, but someone who knows how to effectively prompt an AI just might. Embrace the tools that amplify your output. 🤖",
                "createdAt": "2026-06-18T08:08:52.854Z",
                "updatedAt": "2026-06-18T08:08:52.854Z",
                "__v": 0
            },
            {
                "_id": "6a33a7872db3aa1dbd1eef8e",
                "owner": "6a30f0caf89b6708cf12a313",
                "content": "Learning a new programming language? Build something useless but fun first. The best way to learn is through curiosity, not chores. 🎮",
                "createdAt": "2026-06-18T08:08:39.026Z",
                "updatedAt": "2026-06-18T08:08:39.026Z",
                "__v": 0
            },
            {
                "_id": "6a33a7782db3aa1dbd1eef8d",
                "owner": "6a30f0caf89b6708cf12a313",
                "content": "Burnout isn't a badge of honor; it's a design flaw in your schedule. Rest is a prerequisite for high performance. 🔋",
                "createdAt": "2026-06-18T08:08:24.895Z",
                "updatedAt": "2026-06-18T08:08:24.895Z",
                "__v": 0
            },
            {
                "_id": "6a33a76f2db3aa1dbd1eef8c",
                "owner": "6a30f0caf89b6708cf12a313",
                "content": "Automating a repetitive task saves you 5 minutes today, but it gives you back hours over the next year. What are you automating this week? ⚙️",
                "createdAt": "2026-06-18T08:08:15.279Z",
                "updatedAt": "2026-06-18T08:08:15.279Z",
                "__v": 0
            },
            {
                "_id": "6a33a7652db3aa1dbd1eef8b",
                "owner": "6a30f0caf89b6708cf12a313",
                "content": "The best developers don't memorize every syntax—they master the art of asking the right questions and reading documentation. 🔍",
                "createdAt": "2026-06-18T08:08:05.376Z",
                "updatedAt": "2026-06-18T08:08:05.376Z",
                "__v": 0
            }
        ],

            "limit": 10
